verses.text: The LORD spoke to Jeremiah when King Zedekiah sent Pashhur son of Malchijah and Zephaniah son of Maaseiah, the priest, to ask him,
“Please ask the LORD for us. King Nebuchadnezzar of Babylon is at war with us. Maybe the LORD will do one of his wonders for us and make him back off.”
Jeremiah told them, “Here’s what to tell Zedekiah:

‘The LORD, the God of Israel, says, “Look, I’ll turn back the weapons you’re holding, the ones you’re using against the king of Babylon and the Chaldeans surrounding you outside the walls. I’ll gather the weapons right in the middle of this city.
I’ll fight against you myself, my hand stretched out and my arm strong, with anger and fury and fierce outrage.
I’ll strike the people and animals living in this city. They’ll die in a terrible outbreak of disease.

After that,” says the LORD, “I’ll hand King Zedekiah of Judah, his officials, and the people left in this city after disease, sword, and famine over to Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, to their enemies, and to those out to kill them. He’ll strike them down with the sword. He won’t spare them or show them pity or mercy.”’
“Tell these people, ‘The LORD says, “Look, I’m putting two roads in front of you, the road to life and the road to death.
Anyone who stays in this city will die by the sword, famine, or disease. Anyone who goes out and surrenders to the Chaldeans surrounding you will live. They’ll get out with their life.
I’ve set my face against this city to bring it disaster,” says the LORD. “I’ll hand it over to the king of Babylon, and he’ll burn it down.”’
“Now listen to what the LORD says to the royal house of Judah.

Family of David, the LORD says, ‘See that justice is done in the morning. Pull anyone who’s been robbed out of the hands of the one oppressing them. Otherwise the evil you’ve done will make my anger flare up like a fire nobody can put out.
Look, I’m against you who live in the valley and on the rock above the plain,’ says the LORD. ‘You’re the ones saying, “Who’s coming down to attack us? Who could get inside our homes?”
I’ll punish you for what your actions have produced,’ says the LORD. ‘I’ll set her forest on fire, and it’ll burn up everything around her.’”
